meta.description: Krea 2 character LoRA, ported from a FIELD-PROVEN musubi-tuner template (recovered and shared by its operator 2026-09-19; full record and the term-by-term translation in docs/krea2_field_template_2026_09.md). This is the first Krea 2 preset in this fork backed by runs whose OUTPUT was judged good, rather than by a published guide — but the runs were on musubi-tuner/krea2_train_network.py, not this trainer, so the recipe transfers and the implementation does not. Recipe: rank 32 / alpha 16 (scale 0.5) at LR 2e-4, adamw8bit, bf16 with fp8 base weights (qfloat8 here), gradient checkpointing, SDPA (this trainer's default), 30-70 images with .txt captions, multi-aspect buckets rather than forced square, ~2200 steps, latents and text embeddings cached before the run, checkpoints every 250 steps and kept (9 saves covers a 2200-step run end to end) because the operator picked the final LoRA by testing intermediates for likeness vs generalization. DOES NOT CONTRADICT the fork's other Krea 2 presets: LoRA output scales as alpha/rank x LR (lora_special.py line 116), so this file's 32/16 @ 2e-4, the template's earlier 16/16 @ 1e-4, and krea2_lora_low_vram's 32/32 @ 1e-4 are all the SAME effective 1e-4 - three independent routes to one number. What differs is rank 32's capacity at half scale, which is the reason to pick this file over the 32/32 one for a character. STEPS: 2200 was held roughly constant across 30-70 images, so per-image exposure ran 31 passes (70 images) to 73 (30 images); the in-app advisor tiers it instead (32/image on 30-149 files, 45 below 30) and reproduces the 70-image end almost exactly at 2240. Let the advisor size your steps - at 30-40 images the flat 2200 is 1.5-2.3x its target. REPEATS: the source template documents 10 repeats (70 images x 10 = 700 items/epoch). That is epoch-bounded musubi accounting and does NOT transfer - this trainer is step-bounded and num_repeats only duplicates the file list, so leave it at 1. VAE/TE are not configurable here: arch krea2 wires Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct + the Qwen-Image VAE (extensions_built_in/diffusion_models/krea2/krea2.py). The source template names a HunyuanVideo 3D causal VAE, which is musubi's pairing - unresolved, and nothing you can set from this preset either way. cache_text_embeddings is on (the template caches embeds): it is mutually exclusive with train.diff_output_preservation, so turn it off if you need DOP for trigger bleed. Caption dropout still works cached (a blank embed is cached alongside). Sampling every 250 steps is on for likeness checks - disable it on 16GB. For a roomier/leaner card start from krea2_lora_low_vram (24GB) or krea2_lora_16gb instead; for less identity bleed, krea2_character_lokr.
